description: This file defines the CreateResourceDirectoryAction class, which extends CreateElementActionBase, providing functionality to create new resource directories within an Android project in an IDE environment. It includes methods for dialog invocation, validation, creation, and availability checks based on project context.

classes.name: CreateResourceDirectoryAction
classes.description: A class that provides an IDE action to create new Android resource directories, with dialog handling, validation, and context-aware availability.

methods.name: CreateResourceDirectoryAction
methods.description: Constructs the action, optionally with a specific resource folder type.

methods.name: invokeDialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog to input details for creating a new resource directory and returns the created elements.

methods.name: createValidator
methods.description: Creates an input validator for the resource directory creation process.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new subdirectory with the specified name within the given directory.

methods.name: getErrorTitle
methods.description: Returns the title used for error dialogs.

methods.name: getCommandName
methods.description: Returns the command name for creating a resource directory.

methods.name: getActionName
methods.description: Returns the display name of the action based on directory and new name.

methods.name: isAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the action is available in the current context, ensuring the selected element is a resource directory within an Android project.
